content: getSession() reads from storage/cookies without revalidating against Supabase Auth server, so it must never be trusted for authorization in server code (middleware, route handlers, Server Components). getUser() makes a network call to revalidate the token and is safe for auth checks. getClaims() decodes JWT locally (faster) for identity checks. Use getUser()/getClaims() server-side, never getSession() for authz decisions.
